description: AccelerANTgine's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ANTfrastructure's repository root (default.json); the `extends` line below is the whole adoption, exactly as in the four top-level consumers.

The part this repo cannot get any other way is the git-submodules manager, which Renovate DISABLES by default. third_party/ANTfrastructure is where this repo's code-quality and coverage libraries come from, and it had drifted 54 commits behind before 2026-09-09 with nothing to notice -- no gate in the family checks gitlink freshness.

This repo had NO dependency bot of any kind before this file: no renovate.json and no dependabot.yml. So unlike the other consumers there is no hand-over to sequence and nothing to delete afterwards; this is a pure addition.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure` from ANTfrastructure's DEFAULT BRANCH, not from the pin in third_party/ANTfrastructure, so a preset change reaches this repo only after it is merged there. And the Renovate GitHub App is NOT installed on this repository and will not be (owner decision, 2026-09-09) -- no bot will ever author a commit here. That does not make this file idle: the local CLI reads exactly it. See third_party/ANTfrastructure/docs/dependency-updates.md.

The CMake pins in third_party/CMakeLists.txt are read by the PRESET's customManagers since 2026-10-01 (hub CON46), so this file carries none of its own: a second CMake manager here would report every pin twice, and `renovate-local.sh --apply` refuses a pin reported twice. abseil-cpp, microsoft/GSL and cxxbridge-cmd are read through the `# renovate:` annotation above each; googletest through its release-tag archive URL. Corrosion is pinned to a commit because v0.6.1 lacks fixes this build needs, so nothing tracks it until the next tag.

READ THE COMMENT ABOVE THE ABSEIL PIN BEFORE TAKING ITS BUMP. It must stay >= the absl_TAG FUZZTEST pins in its cmake/BuildDependencies.cmake, or FuzzTest misses targets such as absl::random_mocking_access. Moving abseil UP is safe for that constraint; a FUZZTEST bump may raise the floor.

cxxbridge-cmd's annotation says versioning=semver on purpose. Under the crate datasource's default (cargo) Renovate reads `1.0.191` as the caret range ^1.0.191, resolves it to the newest 1.x and proposes nothing, forever. `cargo install --version` takes a VersionReq, so the value is a lower bound, as the comment above it in third_party/CMakeLists.txt says.
